BSCScan name-tag returned: 0x0C89C0407775dd89b12918B9c0aa42Bf96518820 (TrustSwap: Team Finance Security, BSC lock contract). Docs site is handbook.team.finance. No dedicated 'Deployed Contracts' page found in this run; the security page at handbook.team.finance/team-finance-security-and-audits redirects to a Gitbook page that does not list contract addresses. deployed_contracts_doc set to null — could not locate.

Audit PDF at https://www.team.finance/file/audit.pdf resolved to the security/audits handbook page rather than a downloadable PDF. That page references audits by Hacken and Chainsulting for smart contracts, and a Bailsec audit for the SWAP token. No in-scope address table was extractable from the redirected page. No addresses derived from D3.

GitHub org is github.com/trustswap. Repos found: teamfinance-stakingpool (Solidity, staking pool contract), teamfinance-widget-staking (TypeScript, widget), token-lock-smart-contract-algorand-fixed (Python, Algorand), swaptoken (archived ERC20 SWAP token). No broadcast/run-latest.json, hardhat-deploy, or addresses.json deployment artifacts discovered in this run; ran out of fetch budget before walking individual repos.

Protocol supports 17+ chains per context. Only Ethereum (chainId 1) and BSC (chainId 56) contracts were confirmed via on-chain sources in this run. Avalanche, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Blast, Cronos, Fantom, Kava, Flare, Klaytn, Odyssey, Mantle, LUKSO, Berachain, and Pulse chain addresses were not surfaced. Blockscan multi-chain portfolio for 0xE2fE530C shows Avax C-Chain holdings suggesting the same address is deployed on Avalanche. 0x0C89C0407775dd89b12918B9c0aa42Bf96518820 (BSC) Blockscan shows cross-chain hits on Ethereum, Base, Polygon.

The Ethereum Lock contract (0xE2fE530C) and BSC Security contract (0x0C89C0407775) are not enumerable factories in the standard sense — they accept individual token locks per user (not pool children). The Vesting contract (0x64D06dcc) is labelled VestingFactory. Factory child enumeration not attempted due to fetch budget exhaustion. Stakingpool contract address not discovered on-chain this run.

Role taxonomy applied: lock contracts labelled 'pool' (token locker / vault); vesting factory labelled 'factory'; fee-receiver labelled 'treasury'; implementation contract labelled 'other'; contract creator EOA labelled 'admin'.

All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched Etherscan or BSCScan URLs. Fee-receiver 0x725363e764Ea25233F29a14594F6388858d90b87 is derived from observed internal transaction patterns on Etherscan (not a named tag) — role is tentative 'treasury'.

protocol_metadata.about: Team Finance is a non-custodial token management platform built by TrustSwap that allows blockchain projects to lock team tokens and LP tokens in time-released smart contract vaults. Users can also create vesting schedules for investors and employees, deploy staking pools, run airdrops, and batch-send tokens via multisender — all without writing code. The core locking mechanism uses upgradeable proxy contracts (AdminUpgradeabilityProxy) that hold locked assets until the configured unlock time, at which point the original depositor can withdraw. The platform is audited by Hacken and Chainsulting and operates across 30+ EVM and non-EVM blockchains.
